TDME.description: Time Dependent Material - Compressive Strength (TDME). TYPE selects between a built-in code (CODE) whose CODENAME drives which factor fields apply, or a user-defined function (USER) that carries SCALE and the aDATA function table.

NAME.description: Material name. Used as the unique identifier for the material; a matching name modifies the existing record.

TYPE.description: Material type. CODE uses a built-in design code; USER uses a user-defined compressive-strength function. Case-insensitive.

CODENAME.description: [TYPE=CODE] Design code name that governs which factor fields apply. Required and validated when TYPE is CODE. Case-insensitive.

A.description: [TYPE=CODE] Factor a. Applies when CODENAME is ACI or Korean Standard, or when CODENAME is Japen(Hydration) and bUSE is false.

B.description: [TYPE=CODE] Factor b. Applies when CODENAME is ACI or Korean Standard, or when CODENAME is Japen(Hydration) and bUSE is false.

D.description: [TYPE=CODE] Factor d. Applies when CODENAME is Japen(Hydration) and bUSE is false.

iCTYPE.description: [TYPE=CODE] Cement type index. Applies to CEB-FIP(1990), Ohzagi, KCI-USD12, European, Russian, INDIA(IRC:112-2011), INDIA(IRC:112-2020), CEB-FIP(2010), ABNT NBR 6118(2023), KDS-2016, GILBERT AND RANZI, and to Japen(Hydration) when bUSE is true.

bUSE.description: [TYPE=CODE, CODENAME=Japen(Hydration)] Use concrete data option. When true, iCTYPE (Japanese cement type) is used; when false, factors A, B, D are used.

PZ.description: [TYPE=CODE, CODENAME=Russian] Specific content of the cement paste (P-z).

nAGGRE.description: [TYPE=CODE] Aggregate type index. Applies when CODENAME is INDIA(IRC:112-2020), CEB-FIP(2010), or ABNT NBR 6118(2023).

DENSITY.description: [TYPE=CODE] Weight density. Applies when CODENAME is KDS-2016 or GILBERT AND RANZI.

SCALE.description: [TYPE=USER] Scale factor applied to the user-defined function.

aDATA.description: [TYPE=USER] User-defined function data table. Required when TYPE is USER.
